verdicts.reason: A keeps one clean left-aligned text column with a full-width CTA, but it has real flaws. The circle is jammed against the top edge, the shoe sits high and off-centre inside it, 'back' is left alone on its own line, GROVE was enlarged and restyled, and the FREE DELIVERY badge is stranded at the bottom away from everything. B keeps the original's look better (centred product, badge at top right, good headline wrap), but its alignment is broken: GROVE is centred, the headline and body are left-aligned, and the chips and CTA are pushed right. Those three different edges look arbitrary and leave the CTA feeling disconnected from its copy.
